result.document_summary: A mid-document excerpt of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Articles 1-2) covering business tax provisions, definitions, and the uniform local sales and use tax ordinance, with no rental housing regulation content.
result.notes: This part contains only business tax and sales/use tax provisions (e.g., Sec. 31.0305 business tax on residential rental property, refuse collector tax, trailer park tax, sales tax administration). None of these is a rule in the six in-scope categories: the residential rental business tax is a revenue measure, not a rent limit, eviction, deposit, fee, screening or algorithmic pricing rule. The source URL and page title suggest the Division 11 algorithmic rent-price-fixing prohibition (SDMC 98.1103), but that text does not appear in this part, so no rule is extracted from it.
